Example assay plates

Source: R/data.R
example_plate.Rd

A simulated luminescence screen on two 384-well plates, for the plateHeatmap() module. Column 2 holds 16 negative (DMSO) control wells and column 23 holds 16 positive (fully inhibited) control wells on each plate. The first plate carries a strong evaporation edge effect, which the B-score normalisation removes, and the second a mild one; each holds a few hits.

Usage

data(example_plate)

Format

A data frame with 768 rows and 5 columns:

plate

Plate identifier, "Plate_01" or "Plate_02"

well

Well identifier, "A01" to "P24"

type

"sample", "negative" or "positive"

compound

Compound identifier (simulated)

signal

Luminescence readout

Source

Simulated in data-raw/generate_example_plate.R.

Author

Jared Andrews

Examples

data(example_plate)
head(example_plate)
#>      plate well     type compound signal
#> 1 Plate_01  A01   sample CMP-0001   7878
#> 2 Plate_01  A02 negative     DMSO   8248
#> 3 Plate_01  A03   sample CMP-0002   8722
#> 4 Plate_01  A04   sample CMP-0003   8251
#> 5 Plate_01  A05   sample CMP-0004   8108
#> 6 Plate_01  A06   sample CMP-0005   7772
